phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Benchmarks measure performance.**

**Benchmark features:**

| Feature | Use |
|---------|-----|
| `criterion` | Professional benchmarking |
| `std::time::Instant` | Simple timing |
| `cargo bench` | Run benchmarks |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Benchmarks help you understand performance."

**When to benchmark:**
| Situation | Benchmark |
|-----------|-----------|
| Performance-critical code | ✅ |
| Before optimization | ✅ |
| After optimization | ✅ |
| Comparing approaches | ✅ |

phase2.errorMessage: (No error — but benchmarks in debug mode are not accurate!)
phase2.explanation:
Debug mode has optimizations disabled, making benchmarks inaccurate.

**The fix:**
```bash
cargo bench --release
```

**Rust-chan says:**
"Always benchmark in release mode."
